# `customer_session`

Area: **selfcare** ([all tables](README.md))

A signed-in self-care session (cookie bss_care_session). Only the SHA-256 of the random token is stored.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token_hash` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `customer_login_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `last_seen_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Refreshed at most once a minute; the idle expiry counts from it. |
| `expires_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | The absolute end of the session. |
| `revoked_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Signed out, or ended by a password change or a disabled login. |
